subject: Temporary eval access while procurement mediates payment terms
body:
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@luminahealth.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.ai
Date: 2027-08-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval - next steps while PO is routed

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has escalated our vendor onboarding (we need T&Cs + a W-9 + a brief SOW) and finance is re-routing the PO for an approval that may take 7–10 business days. We still want to keep momentum on model evaluation. Is there a short-term option for limited access so our engineering team can finish the integration tests?

Best,
Ava
Ava Collins
Head of ML Platforms, Lumina Health

---
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@luminahealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval - next steps while PO is routed

Ava —

Totally understand. We can offer a constrained interim plan while procurement finalizes the PO. Proposed guardrails:
- 7 days of access (can extend if needed)
- Token cap: 150k tokens total; concurrency limit to 2 workers
- No retention for customer prompts; ephemeral logs only (we'll export audit logs weekly for you)
- Limited model variants: single verified model to keep cost predictable

I'll attach a short SOW and an interim invoice estimate that procurement can review. If finance needs an official short-term invoice, we can generate it today.

Can Marissa loop in finance ops to confirm we can issue a temporary invoice and mark the account for later billing reconciliation?

Cheers,
Jonas
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Interim-Invoice-Estimate.xlsx (xlsx)

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-02T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval - next steps while PO is routed

Internal note: I pinged finance ops — they said they can provision a one-off invoice labelled "short-term eval" but need the vendor onboarding checklist completed (attached) and a signed short SOW. If we keep the token cap and concurrency limits, they are comfortable with credit terms on a $0–$500 bill that will be reconciled once the PO clears.

Also suggested we set an automatic expiry on the temporary access and a post-access report for Lumina (usage + logs export).

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf)

---
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@luminahealth.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@luminahealth.ai
Date: 2027-08-04T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval - next steps while PO is routed

Jonas / Marissa —

This sounds workable. Procurement will send the W-9 and an executed short SOW by end of day tomorrow. They asked that the temporary access have a hard expiry and that Redwood provide a one-line interim invoice our AP team can close against. Please proceed with the 7-day, 150k-token plan and send the invoice when ready.

Thanks for moving quickly — keeping the integration window open is critical for our timeline.

—Ava
